svg.title: The label changes the conclusion
svg.desc: Same window J = [9/32, 3/8] · same clock · different retained identity An edge records overlap somewhere in J; it does not say all edges occur simultaneously. Merging occurrence identity produces a triangle among 6, 11 and 16. Restoring the labels removes that false local inference. This is local to J: those three runners do meet together at t=0. No nodes are active at the selected safe midpoint.
